school-app-buttons.notes: Checked school-only editing, personal saved/favorite choices, website-rule scope, and preservation of existing Flight Path websites. Buttons do not establish account or client capability authority.

admin-workspace.notes: Checked current destinations and navigation/draft guards. My Desk and discipline entry points remain shelved; Email monitoring is entitlement-dependent. Source review does not establish the exact frontend build serving production.

school-year-and-calendar.notes: Checked distinct school-year, bell/rotation and calendar saves, school-local dates, full reviewed configuration, fixed-time versus period-based classes, and frozen recorded occurrences.

launch-checklist.notes: Checked school identity, enrollment-key/managed-policy setup and connector readiness. Publication, a successful save, source compatibility, and actual managed-Chromebook adoption are distinct. Verify the real student pilot and supported features.

workspace-roster-connector.notes: Checked server setup/client/scopes, exact-domain delegated administrator, Directory and Classroom verification, displayed timestamps, and local disable versus Google revocation. Personal Classroom OAuth, OneRoster/Clever, and MailPilot use separate authorization paths. Root independently verified the current official delegation instructions.

staff-and-access.notes: Checked immutable existing identity, same-name confirmation, former-staff reactivation, separate email/profile saves, renewed sign-in, multi-school central review, active-workflow blockers and explicit assignment replacements/removals. Historical records remain.

students-and-pins.notes: Checked manual/CSV/Classroom/Directory entry, connector requirement, PIN generation/reset and print/CSV/Excel exposure. School student records are separate from official Classes membership and Chromebook records; no student-device assignment workflow.

chromebooks.notes: Checked exact Chromebook Status columns and check-in labels: accepted capabilities are not displayed there. The preserved /classpilot/roster URL starts on Student Roster; choose Chromebook Status explicitly. Feature-specific preflight and effective Google policies are separate.

classes-and-schedules.notes: Checked official teachers/rosters, recurring eligibility, planner inclusion/placement/testing, advisory versus application review, saved preview date versus applied dates, whole-application cancellation boundary, profile deletion preserving applied schedules, and separate eligible history removal.

roster-integrations.notes: Checked full OneRoster versions, Clever district connection and reviewed first import, stable school identity, named reviewed changes, manual/source ownership, stale plans, partial progress, no omitted-student deactivation and held nightly snapshots. Vendor/provider pilot readiness is not inferred from source.

schedule-change-operations.notes: Checked eligible pairs, dated approvals and cancellation before either effective start. Older one-day pair requests remain distinct from current teacher Today schedule period swaps and administrator all-day recovery. Today schedule is enabled per root live configuration verification.

school-settings.notes: Checked narrow explicit saves, canonical school identity, central copy including browser safety, key rotation, personal tools and destructive cleanup. Root verified afterHoursSafetyOnlyV1 and schoolWebsiteBlockEnforcementV1 off; shared teaching resources admitted for only one school. Selectable/stored policy is not rollout activation or client enforcement.

google-workspace-policies.notes: Root checked current Google device, user/browser, and force-install documentation. Copy distinguishes ChromeOS device scope from user/enrolled-browser applicability, avoids compulsory universal Trusted status or unsupported Add new users absolutes, and allows up to 24 hours propagation. Readiness cannot certify external policies.

student-sign-in-policy.notes: Checked separate policy/server/Chromebook evidence, bounded providers and Clever-first destination choice. Root verified restrictionAuthPassThroughV1 limited to one school and lateSignInRestrictionSsoV1 off. Saved policy and a provider visit alone do not establish activation or successful late-sign-in recovery.

dashboard-appearance.notes: Checked school-only Appearance save, teacher custom images, calendar/faith-holiday opt-in, automatic holiday end, kiosk background controls, fixed default/lock and separate compatible-extension sign-in gate behavior. No extension-adoption inference from a version or setting.

coverage-administration.notes: Checked saved versus live setup, scoped permissions, temporary-room claims and room Send destinations, owner-only handoffs, preserved destination deadlines, room ownership across bells, exact release reviews, offline releases and read-only Observe authority. Root verified scheduledClassroomV1 on and screenshotReadOnlyObservationV1 off; no unconditional fresh Observe screenshot or five-second handoff promise. Summary capture/delivery remains separately enabled.

analytics-readiness-safety.notes: Checked completed official-session adoption, actual live-starter counts, terminal failures versus delivery retries, observed/eligible coverage, action/client semantics, retained history, connector/ownership findings and separate safety-case evidence. No zero for unavailable data or fleet-adoption claim.

monitored-browser-time.notes: Root verified Digital Usage and usage rollup on. Checked current-grade versus recorded-class attribution, unclassified temporary supervision, hourly Live versus Final/Partial/unavailable dates, retention, exports and cleanup. Observed browser time does not establish engagement or total device use.

safety-center-review.notes: Checked acknowledgements versus assessment, exact URL approval/revocation, automatic narrow offending-tab close requests during normal monitoring, lack of client-confirmed closure, and saved website policy versus enforcement. Root verified schoolWebsiteBlockEnforcementV1 off; no enforcement activation claim. MailPilot has no trustworthy browser URL action.

email-monitoring.notes: Checked add-on entitlement, server credential warning, distinct read-only Gmail delegation, mailbox verification, watches/errors/resync, Safety Center review and local disable versus Google access revocation. Roster connector delegation grants no Gmail access.

cleanup-and-recovery.notes: Checked distinct connector/OAuth/import/scheduling/device boundaries, safe current-state refresh, guided identity/ownership repair, current-screen versus check-in evidence and irreversible monitoring cleanup versus retained inactive account history. Do not solicit credentials or imply capabilities displayed on Chromebook Status.
